The 2025/2026 placements are already in this count and their cash is in net cash; no further raises are modelled -- a future XR-funding placement would be genuine non-SBC dilution and is a bear-case risk, not in the base count.

The company is simultaneously a placer (HK$1.4bn Feb 2026) and a repurchaser, so the flat count is funded in cash at present.
inputs.fx_note: Statements in RMB (CNY); H shares quoted in HKD on HKEX. Per-share values computed in CNY and converted at CNYHKD 1.1724 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16 close). Direction check: inverse HKDCNY=X 0.8505 (2026-10-17), product 0.997. Placement cross-check: 27.0m x HK$52.00 = HK$1,404m gross vs RMB1,250.0m 'Issue of shares' net of costs in H1 FY2026 cash flow, i.e. ~1.12-1.13 HKD/CNY at Feb-2026 rates; RMB has since strengthened, consistent with the H1 RMB57m FX loss. No A-share listing to parity-check against.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are RMB, so the rate is RMB-built: China 10y CGB ~1.85% + beta ~1.1 x China ERP ~5.3% (Damodaran mature-market ERP plus China country premium) = ~7.7%, plus ~1.3pp small/mid-cap and H-share liquidity premium = ~9.0%. Net cash, so WACC = cost of equity. Same 9.0% in all three scenarios: XR-programme and tariff risk is priced in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities (RMB0.07m at 30 Jun 2026 after the Japan right-of-use lease ended; 37.4m at FY2025) sit in total_debt; lease principal is not deducted in the flows; lease_cost_pct_path 0. Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: None -- profit is 100% attributable to owners of the parent (Blue Optics now 100%-owned since Apr 2026).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF (component build), with the non-US adaptations (CNY flows / HKD quote, SBC-light market, matching-asset rule for the wealth-management book). Conant is an operating manufacturer (resin spectacle lenses, #2 globally by volume, plus an emerging XR/smart-glasses lens line), so no bank/REIT/NAV routing applies. First valuation of this ticker; no memory entry. OWNER FCF FY2025: OCF 536.6 - PPE capex 291.4 = reported FCF 245.2; less SBC 23.6 and bank interest income 13.8 (net cash 1.7bn >> 1x the FCF base) = 207.8. ADJ EBITDA BASE: FY2025 gross profit 917.5 - selling 124.8 - admin 211.1 - other expenses 1.6 + D&A 84.5 + SBC 23.6 = 688.1 (31.5%), EXCLUDING the 22.4 ECL impairment reversal (one-off), government grants 8.9, FVTPL/interest/FX in other income (their source assets are in the bridge). H1 FY2026 on the same basis 418.3 / 1,167.1 = 35.8% (vs 31.0% H1 FY2025): gross margin +1.9pp on customised/functional mix and opex discipline. D&A jumped to 6.1% of revenue in H1 FY2026 (PPE depreciation 69.2m vs 32.5m) as the 2024-26 capex wave (Thailand, Neo Vision XR line, Blue Optics, Japan customisation line) enters service. TIMING: FY0 flows are FY2025 but the balance sheet is 30 Jun 2026, so the H1 FY2026 FCF (-143.2m reported, receivables build + capex) is both in the net cash and inside the projected FY2026 year -- a small conservative overlap (~RMB0.3/sh), left in rather than splitting the year. INTERIM DIVIDEND: RMB0.20/sh approved 21 Sep 2026, payable 23 Oct 2026; the 16 Oct price is ex-entitlement, so the ~99.7m is deducted in the bridge. Buybacks: see buyback_note -- the flat share count is currently funded in cash. SBC is small (1.1% of revenue FY2025, 0.2% H1 FY2026); band is narrow but not collapsed. BAND: SBC is ~0.5% of revenue, so the house/street band is only ~HK$0.5/sh wide (weighted 26.18 vs 26.73); the printed band_position (~1,600%) just says the price sits ~HK$8.5 above even the street basis -- the gap is the XR narrative, not SBC treatment. YEAR-1 RISK: base FY2026 owner FCF of ~RMB262m needs H2 FY2026 FCF of ~RMB400m after the H1 -143m (receivables +234m in H1); if the receivables build is structural (XR customers on longer terms) FY2026 will undershoot.
inputs.segment_build_note: Revenue paths are a two-leg build summed to one growth rate. CORE LENSES (~RMB2.12bn FY2025 ex-XR): H1 FY2026 core ex-XR grew only ~3.3% (1,116.6m vs 1,081.0m) -- standardised -5.7%, functional +11.9%, customised +37% (customised includes XR lenses), with ODM/US tariff drag; base runs core at ~4%, bull ~6%, bear ~1.5-2%. XR LENSES: H1 FY2026 RMB50.5m (+1,475% from RMB3.2m); management gives no number, only 'significant growth'. Base: ~140m FY2026, ~240m FY2027, ~340m FY2028, ~420m FY2029, ~480m FY2030 (~15% of revenue), growing with the category thereafter -- deliberately below the sell-side extrapolations that drove the Jan-2026 rally. Bull: ~1.1-1.2bn by FY2030 (Quark mass production plus two international programmes and the GoerView JV ramp). Bear: XR plateaus ~150-200m as Goertek/Sunny/Crystal-Optech internalise lens work and the 2026 China subsidy pull-forward reverses.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (34% 3yr / 40% 5yr) is inflated by the Dec-2021 IPO, the Jan-2025 Goertek placement and the Feb-2026 HK$1.4bn placement -- it is capital raised, not compounded. Revenue 3yr CAGR (11.9%) selected instead; the base driver path runs below it (7-8% near term) because FY2025 revenue grew only 6.1% and H1 FY2026 core ex-XR only ~3.3%.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF - SBC - interest income across the whole history (SBC nil before FY2025; FY2020 SBC not disclosed, treated nil). The 3yr FCF CAGRs start from a depressed FY2022 base (working-capital build) and are not meaningful; the 5yr owner-FCF CAGR of 1.6% against 14.9% revenue CAGR shows the capex wave (PPE capex 3.7% of revenue FY2021 -> 13.3% FY2025 -> ~15-18% FY2026) has absorbed the earnings growth. EPS growth (27% 3yr) is margin expansion (gross margin 33.9% FY2021 -> 42.0% FY2025) and should not be extrapolated.

base.rationale: EBITDA 34% FY2026 (H1 35.8%, H2 seasonally similar but FX/raw-material noise) holding ~35%: mix gains offset by XR line under-utilisation and ODM price pressure. Capex: H1 FY2026 cash PPE 170m (211.7m incl. prepayments) -> ~400m FY2026 (17%), stepping down to maintenance-plus-growth 6% by FY2032, above terminal D&A 5.5%. Working capital -25% of incremental revenue: FY2025 inventory 602 + receivables 403 - payables 188 - other payables 171 - contract liabilities 57 = ~590 (27% of revenue). Cash tax 13% (FY2025 cash taxes 72.7m on ~580m EBIT; HNTE 15% in China, Thailand BOI holiday from first revenue) drifting to 15% as the Thai holiday expires.

bull.rationale: XR reaches ~RMB1.1-1.2bn by FY2030 (~30% of revenue) with core lenses growing ~6% on own-brand/customised mix; margin to 37.5% on XR operating leverage and premium mix; heavier capex to fund it; larger Thai share keeps tax lower for longer.

bear.rationale: FY2026 is half-reported (+7.6% H1) so the bear bites from FY2027: XR plateaus ~150-200m after the subsidy pull-forward, ODM shrinks under US tariffs, core grows ~1.5-2%. The capacity built for XR is under-used: D&A stays elevated against flat revenue and EBITDA margin gives back the FY2024-26 expansion to ~30% (FY2024 level was 28-29%).

scenario_narratives.base: Conant stays the world's #2 resin-lens maker by volume and keeps shifting mix toward own-brand, functional (myopia-control, photochromic) and customised lenses, but the core grows only ~4% a year: H1 FY2026 core ex-XR grew ~3.3% with standardised lenses down and the ODM/US book tariff-constrained. XR becomes a real but modest second leg -- ~RMB140m in FY2026 off the RMB50.5m H1 print, ~RMB480m by FY2030 (~15% of revenue) as the Quark prescription-lens supply and one or two international programmes reach mass production. The 2024-26 capex wave (Thailand, Neo Vision XR line, Blue Optics, Japan) depresses FCF through FY2027 and then normalises. This is not the sell-side extrapolation that took the stock to HK$64-88 in Jan-2026.
scenario_narratives.bull: Smart glasses become a mainstream category (Alibaba Quark, Meta, Xiaomi, Rokid) and Conant converts its first-mover position -- ~20 programme relationships, the GoerView waveguide JV with Goertek and the Rokid stake -- into a ~RMB1.1-1.2bn XR business by FY2030 at better-than-group margins, while own-brand and customised mix lifts the core lens business to ~6% growth. EBITDA margin climbs to 37.5%; the Thailand base de-risks US tariffs.
scenario_narratives.bear: XR proves to be a 2026 subsidy-fuelled spike concentrated in a handful of programmes: partners-cum-competitors (Goertek, Sunny Optical, Crystal-Optech, Luxshare) internalise lens and waveguide work, Quark volumes disappoint, and XR stalls around RMB150-200m. US tariffs keep shrinking the lower-margin ODM book, 1.74-index raw-material disruption and price competition from Chinese standardised-lens makers erode gross margin, and the capacity built in 2025-26 sits under-utilised, taking EBITDA margin back to ~30%. Growth settles at ~2-2.5% and further placements to fund XR remain a dilution risk not captured in the flat share count.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because the share price's 2026 run rests on an unproven XR pivot concentrated in a few customer programmes with no disclosed long-term contracts, and the core is growing ~3% under US tariffs. Base 50% because the core lens franchise (#2 globally, 42-43% gross margin, net cash RMB1.7bn) is real and self-funding. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent things -- category adoption, Conant keeping share against its own JV partner, and XR margins above group -- to go right at once.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the core lens franchise on its own cash flows and treat XR as an explicitly modelled, deliberately haircut second leg rather than capitalising the January-2026 narrative. The wealth-management book and cash are added at book in the bridge with their income stripped from the flows; the Rokid stake at cost. Risk is charged once, in the scenario flows and weights, at a single RMB-built 9% discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: XR revenue is a ~RMB50m half-year line with 15x growth; base-case extrapolation to ~RMB480m by FY2030 is a judgment with no management number behind it
Customer concentration in XR (Quark, GoerView JV, Rokid-linked programmes) and partners that are also competitors
US tariffs on the ODM book; core ex-XR growth already slowed to ~3% in H1 FY2026
Capex wave: if XR demand ramps slower than capacity, elevated D&A and under-utilisation compress margins (the bear case)
FX: RMB strength against USD/JPY hits a ~65%-overseas revenue base (RMB57m FX loss in H1 FY2026); CNYHKD rate in the conversion also moves the HKD value
Repeated equity placements (Jan-2025, Feb-2026) -- future XR funding raises would dilute the flat share count
RMB1.0bn FVTPL wealth-management book carried at book in net cash; counterparty/mark risk
